game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the sled courier must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Default Armory: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: In Frosted Chapel, repeat each round: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing. Each round, a new warm lanterns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the armor value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Collect 100 points of warm lanterns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Default Armory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Default Armory' (Week 6 slot 4), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Frosted Chapel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how armor changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 46 seconds.
